name: Volumetric Texture Rendering via Image Layers
aliases: Rendering by using the new model of volumetric texture
Volumetric Textures Representation Based on Image Layers
definition: A rendering method where a volume is represented by N 2D images of size X × Y in RGBA format, treated as a volume of N×X×Y voxels. The volume contains precalculated colors (no reflectance information), implying fixed shading and lighting.
